final_draft.answer: No. A live check of the AWS account (111122223333) on 2026-11-18 found that new EBS disks are not encrypted by default in us-east-1.
final_draft.note: Please review before sending. The live check contradicts the approved answer. The approved answer (answer:29de5afc-75bf-4666-badb-7957a0c45f4e, owner security@harborlight.example, valid until 2027-11-18) says 'Yes. New EBS disks in our AWS account (111122223333) are encrypted by default.' A live check at 2026-11-18T03:42:09Z (evidence:e904f922-1bca-4dac-8fd1-60b4ce7f2fd6) found that new EBS disks in that account are not encrypted by default in us-east-1. I did not reuse the approved 'Yes' because the current setting doesn't support it. Two limits on what this shows: the check only covers us-east-1, the configured region, so other regions weren't looked at. And the sources don't say directly that 111122223333 is the production account, though another approved answer (answer:1373939f-c4c4-4a4c-ba07-895a792fa528) calls it 'our production AWS account'. Please send this to the answer owner (security@harborlight.example). They can either turn on EBS default encryption and re-run the check, or update the approved answer. A separate approved answer says customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 (answer:0ac6d657-cd8c-40f5-9357-3ac66254c50c), but I didn't use it because it doesn't address default disk encryption.

answer:29de5afc-75bf-4666-badb-7957a0c45: Yes. New EBS disks in our AWS account (111122223333) are encrypted by default.
answer:0ac6d657-cd8c-40f5-9357-3ac66254c: Yes. Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by our cloud provider's key management service.
answer:07009a5e-c646-43d6-8fc1-247f6c548: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher. Older protocol versions are disabled at the load balancer.
answer:37b80eb5-bb0a-41e3-acb7-3385dabd1: Yes. Our AWS account (111122223333) blocks all public access to S3 buckets account-wide.
answer:1373939f-c4c4-4a4c-ba07-895a792fa: Yes. The root user of our production AWS account (111122223333) has multi-factor authentication.
evidence:e904f922-1bca-4dac-8fd1-60b4ce7: New EBS disks in AWS account 111122223333 are not encrypted by default in us-east-1. Observed 2026-11-18 03:42 UTC.
